steps.name: Given the test logs are cleared for fresh start
Given the superadmin is logged in to collect approval settings
Given the user navigates to internal transfers approval policy settings
Given the user collects all internal transfer approval ranges from company settings
Then the user logs all internal transfer ranges with their limits
Given the user collects all "internal" transfer approvers for all ranges
log ✓ internal approval ranges already collected, skipping...
Then the user logs "internal" transfer approvers for each range
Given the user collects required approvers count for all "internal" ranges
log ✓ Required approvers count collected for internal
Given the user navigates to external transfers approval policy settings
Given the user collects all external transfer approval ranges from company settings
Then the user logs all external transfer ranges with their limits
Given the user collects all "external" transfer approvers for all ranges
log ✓ external approval ranges already collected, skipping...
Then the user logs "external" transfer approvers for each range
Given the user collects required approvers count for all "external" ranges
log ✓ Required approvers count collected for external
Then the superadmin logs out from the application
Given the user logs out from the application
Given the current example is logged with target 'Company' range '2' type 'Internal' test case '85000297' and jira 'TB-1396'
Given the user is logged in and navigates to the transfer page
And the user navigates to the transfer page and clicks on "Add Transfer" button
When the user selects source type as "Flexi Account" from dropdown
